raw_response_text:
{
  "project_id": "P-MNG-ThirdEnergySector",
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk_id": "R01",
      "description": "Short construction season may cause delays if the transmission line is not completed before winter.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Plan civil works to start early in the season, incorporate buffer time in the schedule, and use fast‑track construction techniques.",
      "evidence": "If it cannot be completed before winter, the Project will have more delays with waiting for the next construction season."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R02",
      "description": "Absence of domestic manufacturers for 220 kV poles and conductors may lead to supply delays and quality issues.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Pre‑qualify qualified foreign suppliers, secure early contracts, and implement strict quality‑control inspections on all imported components.",
      "evidence": "no local company who can produce metal poles and conductors meeting the standards for 220kV lines"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R03",
      "description": "Extreme wind, snow, earthquake and flood hazards could damage towers and reduce line reliability.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Apply climate‑resilient engineering standards, conduct site‑specific hazard modelling, and use higher‑grade materials and foundations.",
      "evidence": "enhanced engineering and design standards that consider wind loading, snow, freezing, earthquake and flood"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R04",
      "description": "Transmission line may increase bird collisions and impact avifauna biodiversity.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Install bird‑friendly flight diverters, realign the route away from key habitats, and monitor avian mortality during operation.",
      "evidence": "Transmission lines in Mongolia often involve bird collision... Bird management Plan adjusted route"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R05",
      "description": "Construction and operation expose workers to OHS risks such as falls, electrocution and EMF exposure.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Develop and enforce a comprehensive OHS plan, provide safety training, use insulated tools, and conduct regular site inspections.",
      "evidence": "OHS risks associated with live power lines, working at height, electric and magnetic fields (EMF)"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R06",
      "description": "New PMO lacks experienced financial management staff, risking ineffective fund administration.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Recruit qualified financial officers early, provide bank‑led training, and establish mentorship with experienced staff from previous energy projects.",
      "evidence": "PMO not yet in place and no financial management staff has been appointed"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R07",
      "description": "Weak internal financial controls may lead to unauthorized expenditures or misreporting.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Finalize and implement a detailed Financial Management Manual with segregation of duties, approval matrices and regular internal audits.",
      "evidence": "Weak internal controls: There are not any internal controls related financial management policies and procedures established"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R08",
      "description": "A significant share of locally sourced construction materials may be sub‑standard, causing rework and cost overruns.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Introduce mandatory material testing, enforce compliance with international specifications, and retain a contingency budget for material replacement.",
      "evidence": "40% of construction materials were found unqualified in the local market"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R09",
      "description": "Inadequate budgeting could result in funds being spent on non‑project activities.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Prepare annual budgets aligned to procurement plans, conduct quarterly variance analysis, and require PSC approval for any re‑allocations.",
      "evidence": "Poor budgeting: The project funds not used for the intended purposes"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R10",
      "description": "Evaluation Committee’s limited English proficiency may delay assessment of international bids.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Provide English‑language training for committee members and use bilingual procurement consultants to translate and review documents promptly.",
      "evidence": "Evaluation Committee members normally do not have knowledge and experience in handling English documents, may cause delays"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R11",
      "description": "Frequent changes of decision‑making officials can interrupt procurement and contract approvals.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Formalize delegation of authority in the Project Operational Manual and maintain a continuity log for all key contacts.",
      "evidence": "Frequent change of the decision-making officials for the Project"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R12",
      "description": "Seasonal nature of civil works restricts construction to a narrow window, increasing likelihood of schedule slippage.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Advance procure long‑lead items, mobilize contractors before the season starts, and negotiate penalty/bonus clauses for timely completion.",
      "evidence": "seasonal nature of civil works in Mongolia adds more risks... one construction season"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R13",
      "description": "Ineffective grievance redress could lead to community opposition and project stoppages.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Implement a two‑stage GRM with clear timelines, conduct regular community outreach, and track resolution metrics publicly.",
      "evidence": "Project level grievance redress mechanism (GRM) will replicate the mechanisms used under previous World Bank-financed projects"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R14",
      "description": "Construction activities may temporarily restrict herders’ access to pasture and water sources.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 2,
      "mitigation": "Coordinate with local soum authorities to schedule works around grazing periods and provide alternative water points where needed.",
      "evidence": "temporary restriction of access to resources by local herders (for example, pasture, wells, etc.)"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R15",
      "description": "Potential change of government officials after elections could affect project continuity.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Engage re‑elected officials early, secure written commitments, and maintain a stakeholder coalition supporting the project.",
      "evidence": "Potential changes in Government officials involved in project activities due to election cycle"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R16",
      "description": "Current electricity tariffs are below cost, risking utility cash‑flow and ability to pay for the new line.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Coordinate with the Energy Regulatory Commission to advance tariff reform and incorporate cost‑recovery mechanisms in the loan agreement.",
      "evidence": "Current electricity price is below the cost of service causing financial difficulties for sector utilities"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R17",
      "description": "Climate‑related hazards (floods, wildfires, landslides) could damage the transmission corridor.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Select route through low‑risk terrain, incorporate erosion control measures, and design towers for extreme weather survivability.",
      "evidence": "Mongolia is prone to risks from climate hazards such as flooding, wildfires, and landslides"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R18",
      "description": "Insufficient private investment in VRE may limit the anticipated renewable capacity enabled by the line.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Offer grid‑access incentives, publish a transparent curtailment‑reduction framework, and conduct investor outreach workshops.",
      "evidence": "estimated only 100 MW will be developed by private investors"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R19",
      "description": "Limited procurement capacity of local firms may lead to contract performance issues.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Provide targeted procurement training, use an Owner’s Engineer to monitor contractor performance, and enforce qualified‑bidder criteria.",
      "evidence": "many of them lack human resources... no local company ... can produce metal poles"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R20",
      "description": "Heavy reliance on imported construction materials exposes the project to border closures or pandemic‑related supply disruptions.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Develop a diversified supplier base, maintain strategic stock of critical items, and include force‑majeure clauses in supply contracts.",
      "evidence": "75-80% of construction materials are sourced from outside the country"
    }
  ]
}
